heading: Thursday, November 6, 2025
topLine: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K2 Thinking.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi K2 Thinking
items.summary: Kimi K2 Thinking is an open-weight reasoning model in the K2 family that interleaves step-by-step reasoning with tool use and can run 200 to 300 sequential tool calls. Moonshot reports 44.9% on Humanity's Last Exam with tools, 60.2% on BrowseComp and 71.3% on SWE-bench Verified, measured with native INT4 quantization.
